**Job Description**
 Senior AI Frontend Engineer — Interactive UI \& Visualization
   

  

 Location: Remote / India \| Experience: 5–10 years \| Type: Full\-time
   

  

 Team: Product Engineering — AI Platform \| Reports to: Engineering Manager
   

  

**Company Overview**
 Nuaav is a boutique consulting firm that positions itself as a strategic partner for corporate leaders, focusing on delivering real business results and driving impactful change in complex and rapidly evolving business environments. Unlike large\-scale consulting firms, Nuaav brings the boutique advantage — specialized expertise, personalized attention, agility, and tailored solutions — ensuring higher service quality and true alignment with client needs. Our core service areas include:
   

  

* Product Engineering — end\-to\-end product lifecycle development with emphasis on innovation, reliability, scalable DevOps practices, and integration of emerging technologies such as AI, IoT and Blockchain.
* Data Systems — enterprise\-scale data architecture, integration, governance, real\-time processing, and big data solutions.
* AI and Machine Learning — predictive analytics, automation, and intelligence solutions to optimize strategy, performance and customer engagement.
* User Experience — intuitive, research\-driven design solutions to enhance customer experience and retention.


**About The Role**
 We are looking for an engineer who works at the intersection of AI and complex front\-end engineering. You will design and build rich, interactive interfaces — map\-based polygon and shape editing, geometry annotation, real\-time visualization — and wire them directly into AI and ML backends and inference pipelines. This is a hands\-on role. You will be equally comfortable reasoning about model output and crafting a smooth, performant drawing surface. You will not just consume an API; you will help shape how AI capabilities surface in the product and how people interact with them.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and build complex, interactive UIs — polygon and shape drawing and editing, multi\-layer canvases, draggable vertices, zoom and pan, hit\-testing, and real\-time overlays.
* Integrate front\-end experiences with AI and ML backends: inference endpoints, model serving, streaming responses, long\-running jobs, and data pipelines.
* Translate model output — estimates, segments, confidence, predictions, detections — into intuitive, responsive visual interfaces that a non\-technical user can act on.
* Own features end to end, from UX prototyping through API and data\-contract design with backend teams to production deployment.
* Optimise rendering performance for large datasets and high\-frequency interaction (Canvas, SVG, WebGL).
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code. Jest and React Testing Library suites are CI gates on this project, not documentation.
* Use Cursor and MCP as part of daily development, and help shape how the team applies AI\-assisted engineering to real delivery.
* Collaborate with ML engineers and product on what is feasible, what is fast, and what feels good to use.
* Contribute to architecture decisions and to the data contracts between the interface and the services behind it.


**Required**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 5–10 years of professional software engineering experience, with strong depth in modern front\-end development.
* React — production depth. Component architecture, hooks, state management, and performance in a complex single\-page application.
* JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 — including the HTML5 Canvas API, and responsive, portable styling that survives being lifted into another application.
* React Testing Library and Jest — component and hook tests you would expect to block a merge, not tests written after the fact.
* Node.js — build tooling, dev servers, mock harnesses that unblock parallel front\-end and backend work, and MCP server work.
* Cursor — daily AI\-assisted development. Your workflow will be discussed and reviewed alongside your code.
* MCP (Model Context Protocol) — connecting AI models and agents to external tools and data sources.
* Ability to reason about coordinate systems and rendering performance — the difference between where a shape is stored and where it is painted, why a click tolerance behaves differently at different zoom levels, and what to do when a canvas starts to stutter. Prior experience with a specific graphics library is welcome but not required; this reasoning is.
* Solid grasp of AI and ML concepts, with hands\-on experience integrating against model or inference APIs — LLMs, computer vision, or similar.
* Comfort working across the stack — consuming and helping design REST and WebSocket APIs, and reasoning about data contracts rather than accepting whatever arrives.
* Strong eye for UX, performance and detail in interactive applications.
* Excellent written communication and the ability to work autonomously in a remote, distributed team.


**Good to Have**
* TypeScript — this project is data\-contract heavy, so typing carries real weight even though it is not a gate.
* MapLibre GL, Mapbox GL or deck.gl, or any interactive graphics library — Konva, Fabric.js, PixiJS, D3 — including polygon or geometry editing.
* Next.js and server\-side rendering.
* API design experience — OpenAPI or AsyncAPI schemas, versioned contracts, and contract testing.
* GIS and mapping, computer vision tooling, data annotation and labelling platforms, or CAD\-style interfaces.
* The Figma MCP server and design\-to\-code workflows — pulling design tokens, components and layout data from Figma to drive AI\-assisted UI generation and keep code in sync with design.
* Real\-time and streaming UIs, and state management for collaborative editing.
* Python with FastAPI — typed async REST APIs, Pydantic validation, and serving inference endpoints.
* Prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, or building agentic and LLM\-powered features.
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and CI/CD.

title: Technical Lead - Digital Tagging & Privacy Platforms
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a hands\-on Technical Lead to lead the technical implementation and ongoing evolution of our enterprise digital tagging and privacy ecosystem. The role will work primarily on Tealium and will be responsible for client\-side and server\-side tagging, digital data collection, consent integration, and tagging across modern commerce platforms including Shopify. Prior Tealium experience is preferred; however, candidates with deep hands\-on experience in other enterprise tag management platforms and strong server\-side tagging expertise will be considered.
   

  

**Tag Management \& Server\-Side Data Collection**
* Serve as a hands\-on technical lead for our Tealium\-based tagging ecosystem
* Design, configure, implement, and troubleshoot client\-side and server\-side tagging solutions
* Develop scalable event collection and routing patterns across websites, commerce platforms, analytics and media destinations
* Define data\-layer standards, event schemas, naming conventions, and reusable tagging patterns
* Lead implementation of integrations with platforms such as GA4, Google Ads, Meta and other analytics and media platforms
* Determine appropriate client\-side versus server\-side implementation patterns based on performance, privacy, reliability and technical requirements
* Implement monitoring and validation to identify missing, duplicated or incorrectly routed events


**Shopify Tagging**
* Lead technical tagging implementations across Shopify / Shopify Plus
* Implement digital behavioral and ecommerce event collection, including product views, cart activity, checkout and purchase events
* Understand and work within Shopify's modern tagging architecture, including Customer Events, Web Pixels and checkout extensibility
* Design solutions for custom events and integrations where standard Shopify events do not meet business requirements
* Partner with commerce engineering teams to ensure Shopify events are reliably captured and routed through Tealium


**Consent \& Cookie Privacy**
* Support the technical implementation and ongoing management of OneTrust Cookie Consent / CMP
* Integrate OneTrust consent signals with Tealium and downstream analytics, advertising and marketing technologies
* Ensure tags and server\-side integrations execute according to the appropriate consent state and privacy requirements
* Support cookie classification, consent categories, preference management and consent\-state propagation
* Partner with Privacy and Legal teams to translate privacy requirements into technical controls


**Technical Leadership \& Governance**
* Establish engineering standards and implementation patterns for tagging, event collection and consent management
* Review and provide technical direction for implementations delivered by internal teams and external partners
* Lead troubleshooting of complex issues spanning the website, Shopify, Tealium, OneTrust and downstream platforms
* Establish QA and validation practices for digital data collection
* Maintain technical designs, implementation standards and documentation
* Serve as the technical escalation point for tagging and consent\-related issues


**Requirements**
* Enterprise Tag Management Systems (Google Tag Manager, Adobe Experience Platform Tags/Launch, Ensighten, mParticle)
* Server\-side tagging and event collection
* JavaScript
* APIs
* JSON
* HTTP/network requests
* Browser debugging
* Web technologies
* Data layer design and event\-driven tracking architectures
* Shopify / Shopify Plus tagging and ecommerce event collection
* Consent Management Platform (CMP) implementation (e.g., OneTrust)
* Cookies and consent signals
* Privacy\-aware digital data collection
* GA4 implementation and digital analytics/event tracking
* Troubleshooting data flow across browser, server, tag management and downstream platforms


**Preferred Skills**
* Tealium iQ, EventStream, Functions
* OneTrust
* Shopify Customer Events, Web Pixels and checkout extensibility
* Google Cloud or major cloud platform
* Server\-side events integration with Google, Meta and other media platforms
* Large\-scale, multi\-brand and multi\-region digital ecosystems
* CDPs, Customer 360 platforms, identity and downstream audience activation


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in digital analytics implementation, tagging, web engineering or related technical disciplines
* Deep hands\-on experience with an enterprise Tag Management System (TMS) such as Google Tag Manager, Adobe Experience Platform Tags/Launch, Ensighten, mParticle or similar
* Strong experience designing and implementing server\-side tagging or server\-side event collection
* Strong understanding of JavaScript, APIs, JSON, HTTP/network requests, browser debugging and web technologies
* Experience designing and implementing data layers and event\-driven tracking architectures
* Experience with Shopify / Shopify Plus tagging and ecommerce event collection
* Experience implementing or integrating a Consent Management Platform (CMP) such as OneTrust
* Strong understanding of cookies, consent signals and privacy\-aware digital data collection
* Experience implementing GA4 and digital analytics/event tracking
* Ability to troubleshoot data flow across browser, server, tag management and downstream destination platforms

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Forward Deployed Engineer
 



**Experience:** 
 5\+ Years
 



**Location:** 
 Noida
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Contract\-to\-hire (full time conversion after 6 months based on performance)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Forward Deployed Engineer who can work closely with customers to understand their technical and business requirements and build practical solutions using software integrations, automation, analytics and AI.
 



 This role
 **combines software development, system integration, AI, cloud technologies and customer\-facing technical consulting.** 
 You will work closely with customers as well as Engineering, Product, Customer Success and other internal teams to design, develop, deploy and optimize solutions.
 



 Approximately
 **70–80% of the role will involve hands\-on technical implementation** 
 , with around
 **30% involving direct customer interaction.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work directly with customers to understand their technical requirements, workflows and business challenges.
* Design, develop and deploy AI agents, integrations, automations and workflow solutions.
* Build integrations between DevRev and customers' SaaS and non\-SaaS systems using APIs, webhooks and event\-driven architectures.
* Develop solutions using TypeScript, JavaScript, Python and related technologies.
* Work with REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, real\-time communication and Pub/Sub architectures.
* Build and manage one\-way and two\-way data synchronization between multiple systems.
* Perform data mapping, schema transformation and integration across heterogeneous systems.
* Apply LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, function calling and generative AI techniques to build intelligent solutions.
* Work with semantic search and AI evaluation techniques to improve the accuracy and performance of AI\-powered solutions.
* Write SQL queries, analyze data and develop dashboards to generate actionable business insights.
* Rapidly develop prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts and convert successful solutions into production\-ready implementations.
* Conduct technical demonstrations and workshops for customers and stakeholders.
* Deploy solutions using cloud/serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Functions.
* Follow modern DevOps practices including CI/CD, containers, logging, monitoring and observability.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and proactively identify and resolve implementation blockers.
* Work closely with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Support and Revenue teams.
* Help customers adopt technical workflows, integrations, configurations and advanced platform capabilities.
* Create clear technical documentation for solutions, integrations and processes.
* Be willing to travel extensively for customer implementations, workshops and engagements.








**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 5\+ years of experience in software development, systems integration, platform engineering or a related technical role.
* Strong hands\-on programming experience with TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Python.
* Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks and system integrations.
* Experience with data synchronization, data mapping, schema transformation and integration between multiple systems.
* Understanding of event\-driven architecture, Pub/Sub or real\-time communication systems.
* Practical experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, function calling or AI agents.
* Experience deploying applications using cloud/serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda or Google Cloud Functions.
* Understanding of CI/CD, containers, logging, monitoring and application observability.
* Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
* Understanding of data modeling and graph\-based data structures.
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar context\-aware integration approaches.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to work directly with customers and travel up to 80% when required.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with Go.
* Prior experience in a customer\-facing engineering, solutions engineering or technical consulting role.
* Experience building AI\-powered enterprise applications.
* Experience working with SaaS platforms and enterprise integrations.
* Experience conducting technical demos, workshops or proof\-of\-concepts.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* We are looking for someone who is hands\-on technically, comfortable speaking with customers, strong in integrations and interested in applying AI to real\-world business workflows.
